subject.title: fix(telegram): keep over-limit-name models selectable in /model picker (#98221)

question: After the ordering bug is fixed, should this PR be the canonical fix for the Telegram over-limit model callback issue, or should maintainers choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 instead?
rationale: Two open candidate PRs fix the same user-visible bug with different callback contracts, and the provider/model callback format should be intentionally owned before merge.

options.title: Fix this PR and make it canonical
options.body: Keep the minimal name-based-first design, repair ordering parity, and land this branch as the canonical fix.

options.title: Use the sibling candidate
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98694 if maintainers prefer its broader indexed callback contract, then pause or close this PR.

options.title: Hold both for owner selection
options.body: Keep both candidates open until a Telegram owner explicitly selects the callback format, accepting another review round trip.

recommendation.title: Fix this PR and make it canonical
recommendation.body: Keep the minimal name-based-first design, repair ordering parity, and land this branch as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing owner from the callback byte-limit and `/models` command-path history.
